Name: FS - Animal Features
Author: MousyModder
Description:
[center][font=Courier New]✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦﻿[/font][/center][center][font=Courier New]
> Hello! Mousy Modder back, it's been a while![/font][/center][center][font=Courier New]
> As requested on my [url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17518]previous mod[/url]﻿, I've compiled a few different hats and accessories... The main focus [b]was [/b]the cat ears, but I decided to add different ones too! 

> To find these in-game, you'll need to use the [i]hand mirror[/i] included in the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9969]Fashion Sense[/url]﻿ mod!

> There are different types of ears available in [i]light, dark, and pastel[/i] colorations, so they won't be too dark or desaturated for your chosen hair color! In addition to the ears, I've included tails and horns! I hope you have fun customizing your farmer!

✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦ . 　⁺ 　 . ✦

Plans:
> Add Fennec Fox Features!
> Add Bear and Raccoon Features!
> Add Wings!
> Adjust the ear colors to match one uniform color palette!
> Add different animal options!
> Animate?
[/font][/center]

Downloads.Description: Adds more features AND animated tails!
